title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.193 - Added `promptSuggestions` option to Browser SDK `query()` to opt the remote CLI into emitting follow-up suggestions - Fixed brief console window flashes on Windows when spawning CLI subprocesses ## 0.3.192 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.192 ## 0.3.191 - Added `old_source` field to `NotebookEdit` tool results for `replace` and `delete` operations, enabling inline diffs - Added `seven_day_overage_included` to `SDKRateLimitInfo.rateLimitType` for per-model weekly usage limits - Added `model_scoped` array to usage response for per-model weekly limit windows with utilization and reset times
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
